normalization: Lowercase normalized leading action head from the ABC-Bot segment annotation.
assignment_rule: Every normalized label is assigned to exactly one category.

acquire_release.description: Acquire control of an object or relinquish it at a destination.

transport_reposition.description: Move, transfer, locate, load, unload, or store an object without fixture engagement being the defining action.

assembly_contact.description: Engage or disengage an object with a fixture, holder, socket, or support.

articulated_mechanism.description: Operate a rigid articulated, rotational, fastening, locking, or closure mechanism.

deformable_manipulation.description: Change the shape or arrangement of a deformable object.

tool_material_operation.description: Use a tool or manipulate loose material through a task-specific operation.

correction_failure_control.description: Correct, recover from, or reset an unsuccessful or off-nominal execution.
